answer: In this PoA design, each validator’s reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained, verifiable honest service rather than a brief burst of activity. EigenTrust matrix factorization, enhanced by reciprocity-weighted transitivity, assigns freshly spawned sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; lacking trusted paths, they cannot pass consensus, whether disguised as marble, lotus, or a voyage of coordinated nodes.
